notes.title: Brightness settings, zombie wallhacks, and flashlight alignment
notes.content:
Added brightness settings to the settings options for those who are having a hard time seeing anything.

Made it so that zombies cannot attack you through solid objects, they can still hit you through boards and gaps in cemetery fences or over the top of short objects, etc.

Flashlight alignment has been adjusted to match with aim a little better.

notes.title: Quality Settings and Ping System
notes.content:
New Stuff

 Added quality settings dropdown in display settings
 Added ping system (X on keyboard or left d-pad on controller).


Known Issues

 Flashlight offset
 Invisible shoot-able box around base of spawn point

notes.title: Add Auto Reload, Fix Some Bugs
notes.content:
Added auto reload when magazine is empty (let go of the shoot button).

Fixed alignment of held guns, so it looks like you're shooting correctly.

Fixed muzzle flash alignments.

Fixed UI scaling for larger screens.

Removed toggle objectives, so you can't accidentally turn your objectives off.

notes.title: Fixed Coop Joining
notes.content: Fixed a SMALL bug that was keeping players from joining their friends in zombie slaying action. So far a perfect AAA launch. Right on schedule.
